summary: Alphatec Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $300M senior secured credit agreement comprising a $175M term loan A and a $125M revolving facility, maturing in five years with a springing maturity tied to its 2030 convertible notes. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is described. The filing solely concerns ordinary-course borrowing and financial obligations.
